title: Pixel art model training progress: style consistency
author: HugoDzz
selftext: These are 16x16, same prompt with 3 different styles. I've made a [post here](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1vsp8c6/training_the_pixel_art_model_for_the_new_golden/) about how this pixel art model started. Still WIP!

comments.author: Lordxb
comments.body: You keep on posting here but your not posting GitHub instead of monetizing or in this case just self advertising your product!!

replies.author: HugoDzz
replies.body:
TBD! This version will not fit on consumer hardware anyway, but very interested in making a mini version!

Still WIP here, a lot of work is still needed.

replies.author: Lordxb
replies.body: Really? Mind explaining how much vram is needed?

replies.author: HugoDzz
replies.body: Around 30GB. But again, it’s not optimized, not even finished! And also, a mini version fitting 10GB would be great but need to spend more time and work.

replies.author: Lordxb
replies.body: That’s still consumer hardware, 5090 is 32gigs of vram and modded 4080 and 3080 can get bigger vram with offloading to ddr5. Then theirs Strix Halo with 128gig unified and Mac’s Mini/Studio is all consumer hardware!!

comments.author: thetinytrex
comments.body: I would be interested in using this but there doesn't seem to be a good way to try it. Like I'm not opposed to paying for a service if it's good. But I can only invite a friend (why the hell would I do that without trying it) and join discord for some credits. At least have daily credits or a limited way of generating with no exports or something just to see what kind of results I get and if it will fit my needs.

replies.body: Feel free to DM me! Happy to let you expriment with the model.
